parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom supporting structure of the display cabinet, made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support for the entire cabinet structure.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a wooden panel that covers the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body that holds all other parts together.
parts.Functional_description: It provides rigidity and defines the shape of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: The bottom shelf is a horizontal wooden panel inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: The middle shelf is a wooden panel positioned between the top and bottom shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the storage space and supports items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: The top shelf is the uppermost internal wooden panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed near the top of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Countertop
parts.Basic_description: The countertop is the flat upper surface of the cabinet made of wood.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a surface for placing decorative or functional items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move.

parts.name: Glass (Left Panel)
parts.Basic_description: The left glass panel is a transparent section of the cabinet door.
parts.Functional_description: It allows visibility of the cabinet’s contents while protecting them.
parts.Movement_description: It moves with the door when opened or closed.

parts.name: Glass (Right Panel)
parts.Basic_description: The right glass panel is another transparent section of the cabinet door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides visibility and protection for the cabinet’s contents.
parts.Movement_description: It moves with the door when opened or closed.
